comments.text:
For anyone who is wondering, this song is about Miku cooking to make the person on the other side of the screen happy. 

It compares the ups and downs of life to making Bavarova (which is a sweet custard pudding), how the “sweet” moments are better after the hardships. Someone else also pointed out that vanilla extract takes a long time to make, so when Miku sings “your tears will someday turn into vanilla” she means that someday (even if it takes a very long time) you will be happy. 

The “yogurt lady” is a reference to a children’s song about people in Korea who sell yogurt.
